# The American Society of Cinematographers

> > The American Society of Cinematographers (ASC) is the premier professional organization for cinematographers, offering industry news, technical resources, awards recognition, and educational programs for the art and craft of filmmaking.

The ASC publishes American Cinematographer magazine, hosts the annual ASC Awards ceremony, and provides educational outreach through the ASC Clubhouse. The site covers cinematography techniques, equipment reviews, product announcements from manufacturers like Arri, Godox, and DZOFilm, and profiles of distinguished cinematographers and their work.

## Key Topics

- American Society of Cinematographers (ASC)
- American Cinematographer magazine
- Cinematography techniques and craft
- ASC Awards
- Lighting equipment and LED technology
- Camera equipment and lenses
- Arri, Godox, Sony camera systems
- DoPChoice, Kino Flo lighting solutions
- Post-production workflows
- Educational outreach programs
- ASC Clubhouse
- Cinematography gear reviews
- Documentary and narrative filmmaking
- Visual storytelling
- Film industry professionals

## ASC Awards & Recognition

- [38th ASC Awards](https://theasc.com/38th-asc-awards): 38th ASC Awards ceremony recognizing excellence in cinematography
- [Guillermo del Toro: Fantastical Visions](https://theasc.com/articles/guillermo-del-toro-asc-awards-honoree): ASC Board of Governors Award honors Guillermo del Toro's visual artistry

## Cinematography Features & Techniques

- [Observing Ancient Creatures in 'Prehistoric Planet: Ice Age'](https://theasc.com/articles/prehistoric-planet-ice-age-cinematography): Jonathan Jones' practical cinematography approach for Prehistoric Planet
- [Chef's Table: A Tasting Menu](https://theasc.com/articles/chefs-table-a-tasting-menu): Adam Bricker ASC on shooting Netflix's Chef's Table documentary series
- [The Chair Company: Shooting Episode 1's Conspiratorial Climax](https://theasc.com/articles/the-chair-company-cinematography): Ashley Connor's cinematography for The Chair Company finale scene
